name: Doro AB (publ)
summary: Doro AB (publ), a technology company, develops products and services for seniors. It offers easy-to-use mobile and smart phones, home telephones, and accessories; corded phones and cordless models; stationary and mobile social alarms, digital social alarms, GPS-alarms, and telecare solutions; and products for remote supervision and monitoring. The company also provides end-to-end digital alarm chain services. It sells its products in approximately 28 countries primarily through a network of telecom operators, distributors, specialists, and dealers. The company serves public actors, civil society, and private companies. Doro AB (publ) was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Malmö, Sweden.
